1.title: In Maine Senate Race, Jackson Sprints Ahead of Pack, as Bellows Drops Out
1.summary: Troy Jackson, a progressive, solidified his clear edge in the contest to replace Graham Platner, as Shenna Bellows and Nirav Shah are dropping their bids.

2.title: Shakira, Madonna, Justin Bieber and BTS perform at colourful World Cup half-time show
2.summary: Robbie Williams and Jennifer Hudson also performed, with Kylie Jenner and Timothee Chalamet among the celebrities in the crowds.

3.title: At World Cup Final, Trump Seeks to Bask in Another Sports Championship
3.summary: The president flew in Marine One over MetLife Stadium on Sunday ahead of his arrival. It was the second time recently that he sought to seize the spotlight at a major sporting event.

4.title: Iran War Live Updates: Another U.S. Service Member Is Killed as Two Sides Edge Toward Wider War
4.summary: The Pentagon said a service member was killed in northern Iraq on Saturday while troops disposed of an Iranian drone. It also said “unidentified remains” had been found in Jordan, where an earlier attack had left two soldiers dead and another missing.

5.title: US soldier killed and one injured after Iranian attack in Iraq
5.summary: The US military reports another death a day after two of its soldiers were killed in Jordan.

6.title: Russia Batters Kyiv in One of the Largest Missile Assaults of the War
6.summary: On Saturday, Ukraine hit two warehouses in Russia in strikes that killed at least eight people and injured 62.
